correctness.rationale: Exact positive-denominator reduction proves degree at most 2m-2 and the two-zone quadratic formula. Vieta root product/sum and positive discriminant prove the necessary and sufficient two-positive-simple-roots condition; constant/linear/double-root boundaries and identical rankings are handled. Exact geometry demonstrates genuine inverse-square feasibility. A standalone rational checker independently corroborated 16,663 identities and examples; finite testing is not substituted for universal analytic proof.

value.rationale: The precise demand-zone lower bound and complete strict two-site double-crossover phase diagram resolve a natural market-share ranking problem under continuous retail quality investment. The reentrant choice region is robust and realized by real planar distances, so it is more than an arbitrary numerical polynomial. It distinguishes increasing individual site attractiveness from nonmonotone optimal site choice, with clear limitations regarding costs, strategic reaction and empirical fit.
